answer: Use beacon tickets: each agent locks 500 POA for 7 days to draw one ticket from a verifiable random beacon - a wharf issuing a single pass per ship, never two. Tickets expire in 24 hours and cannot be sold or transferred, so a bot farm cannot stockpile them. Faking 100 identities costs 50,000 POA locked for a week, while one honest ember of work earns a ticket cheaply. The dune of expiring tickets keeps shifting, so an attacker must keep paying, and the network simply ignores any claim without a live ticket.
